about: Front PT0: Brazilian Portuguese strings that may equal their English source, each with a reason (plan front-i18n-pt-br.md §3.3). Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.catalog:instructorMode.optionsClosedOk: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.map:helpMenu.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.map:languageChoice.legend: bilingual on purpose so either reader finds the selector (Idioma is also the Portuguese word)
entries.original:OK: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.original:Zoom: the same word in Brazilian Portuguese software (zoom)
entries.original:Pulsar: the same word in Portuguese (IAU OAE pt-BR)
entries.original:Angstroms: unit name, the same in Portuguese
entries.original:PEpoch (MJD):: timing parameter name and MJD, kept as in pulsar catalogues
entries.catalog:siteClock.utValue: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.catalog:siteClock.hoursValue: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.catalog:runningClock.coordinateValue: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.catalog:horizon.degrees: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.catalog:motion.rateOption: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.catalog:htl.row: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.catalog:multispec.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.catalog:scopeAccess.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.catalog:optionsFile.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.catalog:instrumentParameters.errorOk: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.map:fieldInfo.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.map:observatory.common.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.map:observatory.skyCoords.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.map:polish.spectrometerIndex.routes.4.la: instrument name (Multi-Spec), kept as VIREO names it
entries.map:camera.filterNames.1: photometric filter letter (band name), the same in every language
entries.map:camera.filterNames.2: photometric filter letter (band name), the same in every language
entries.map:camera.filterNames.3: photometric filter letter (band name), the same in every language
entries.map:camera.filterNames.4: photometric filter letter (band name), the same in every language
entries.map:camera.filterNamesIr.0: photometric filter letter (band name), the same in every language
entries.map:camera.filterNamesIr.1: photometric filter letter (band name), the same in every language
entries.map:camera.filterNamesIr.2: photometric filter letter (band name), the same in every language
entries.map:camera.accessReason.ready: empty on purpose (no reason when the telescope is ready)
entries.map:camera.peakCount: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.map:camera.sourceWithHash: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.map:camera.rowCounts: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.catalog:ownResults.bits: the same word in Portuguese (bits) and a hex parameter
entries.catalog:velocity.column: a format of symbols, units and a number type only (v · km/s · float32)
entries.catalog:hubble.ratioColumn: a formula and units only (v/D · km/s/Mpc)
entries.catalog:lss.dialog.dec: coordinate abbreviation kept (declinação, Dec) and degree unit
entries.catalog:lss.exposure.elapsed: a format of parameters, numbers and units only
entries.catalog:fieldSpec.kind.qso: the same word in Portuguese (quasar, IAU OAE pt-BR)
entries.map:wedge.columns.index: the number sign as a column header (#)
entries.map:wedge.columns.dec: the coordinate abbreviation (Dec) as a column header
entries.map:wedge.columns.velocity: a symbol and its unit, V (km/s)
entries.map:wedge.sha256: a hash name kept in English (SHA-256)
entries.map:wedge.detail.velocity: a symbol and a number format (V binary32)
entries.map:wedge.detail.z: a symbol and a number format (Z binary32)
entries.map:wedge.detail.pixel: the same word in Portuguese (pixel) and the coordinate symbols (x, y)
entries.catalog:classLines.option: only placeholders, a unit and a separator ({wavelength} Å · {label})
entries.catalog:probe.shaLabel: a hash name kept in every language (SHA-256)
entries.catalog:photo.caption: only placeholders and a separator ({label} · {polarity})
entries.catalog:viewport.range: only placeholders, a unit and symbols ({minimum}–{maximum} Å · {zoom}×)
entries.catalog:nativeResults.storage.binary32: a Delphi type name and a bit count (Single · 32 bits)
entries.catalog:nativeResults.storage.binary64: a Delphi type name and a bit count (Double · 64 bits)
entries.catalog:ph.fixed: the photometric band letters and the telescope name (U / B / V · {telescope}), no words
entries.catalog:ph.seriesSecondsOption: a parameter and a unit symbol ({seconds} s), the same in Portuguese
entries.catalog:nc.axisColor: axis label with a symbol and a unit (B−V (mag))
entries.catalog:obsHr.sha: the hash name SHA-256, the same in Portuguese
entries.catalog:obsHr.colPixel: «Pixel (x, y)»: pixel is the same word in Portuguese (as PT2 kept it), with coordinate symbols
entries.catalog:obsHr.kind.magnitudes: the word magnitudes is the same in Portuguese (magnitudes)
entries.catalog:pleiadesLab.sourceFile: a file name, its size in bytes and its SHA-256 ({name} · {bytes} bytes · SHA-256 {sha256}); «bytes» is the same in Portuguese
entries.map:variableStars.typeOption: a template of placeholders around an em dash
entries.map:variableStars.columns.7: an empty header cell (the row action column)
entries.map:variableStars.noPeriod: an em dash for no value
entries.map:clusterHr.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
